correctness.rationale: For symmetric length-two palindromic insertion ab→abba in any monoid context, first symbol and length parity are invariant; the length of the first constant run changes only by +2 if the duplication is strictly inside it, making the four run types invariant. The explicitly displayed independent forward chains for 010 and 011 reach common descendant 01101100001, establishing 010≡011 and its complemented relation. Consequently abuv≡ab for distinct a,b and any two-letter uv: the local relation changes the third symbol to a and fourth to b, giving abab≡ab. Iterated suffix-pair erasure and reduction of initial constant runs by aa↔aaaa supply canonical representatives for each signature. This proves 19 monoid congruence classes (1 empty +2 singleton +2 first letters×2 parities×4 types) and length-slice 1,2,4,6,8 from n>=4. Independent signature enumeration n=0..8 confirms cardinalities, and pinned verifier code checks the chains and finite graph through length14. The infinite classification rests on the symbolic reduction, not finite enumeration.
